question: Which of the following natural ports is known as the 'Queen of the Arabian Sea'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kochi.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __The ‘Queen of Arabian Sea’:__

__
 
• Kochi port is known as the 'Queen of Arabian Sea' as it was an important trade center for species on the western coast of India from the 14th century.
 
• Occupied by the Portuguese Empire in 1503, Kochi was the first of the European colonies in colonial India.
 
• Kochi:
 
 
• It is a part of the Ernakulam district.
 
• Kochi was the first of the European colonies in Colonial India.
 
• It remained the main seat of Portuguese until 1530.
 
• It is called the Judicial Capital of Kerala as the High Court of Kerala is situated here.
